title: GTA 6 story length: reportedly 50 hours, matching RDR2
description: GTA 6 story length is reportedly 50 hours across about 100 missions, per TweakTown, with the PS5 Platinum trophy said to need around 200 hours of play.

body.text: GTA 6 story length is reportedly about 50 hours, according to TweakTown, which would match Red Dead Redemption 2 even though the new game's map is far larger. The figure traces back to Insider Gaming's Tom Henderson, who says it reflects impressions from media members who have already played the game. It matters because it gives Indian players a rough idea of how much time to set aside before the November 19 launch, though none of it is official.
GTA 6 story length: what the report says
Henderson says the campaign runs across roughly 100 missions split into five chapters. The 50-hour estimate covers the main story only, without side activities.

Rockstar North co-studio head Rob Nelson gave a bigger number earlier. He told The New York Times his own playthrough in February took 80 hours. That run included optional goals with narrative ramifications and a lot of wandering, so it is a different measure from the story-only figure.
How it compares with GTA 5 and RDR2

TweakTown puts GTA 5's story at around 32 hours and Red Dead Redemption 2's at about 50. That would make GTA 6 equal to Rockstar's longest campaign so far, despite a map the outlet describes as much larger than either of those games.

items: Red Dead Redemption 2 story: about 50 hours
GTA 6 story (reported): about 50 hours across roughly 100 missions

body.text: Completionists face a much longer road. Henderson says the PS5 Platinum trophy, or the Xbox equivalent if one exists, will take about 200 hours. That is more than double GTA 5 and close to RDR2, which TweakTown says averages around 196 hours.

A large chunk of that time comes from a chore RDR2 players will remember: finding and photographing 170 different animal species across Leonida. Henderson also expects some RNG-based trophies, likely linked to the casino and gambling.
An earlier datamine found 55 PS5 trophies, including the Platinum, and Xbox should have the same total.

Every objective at launch is reportedly single-player or story-oriented. There is no word on when a GTA Online successor will arrive, although the launch build contains code related to multiplayer modes.
Treat all of these numbers as estimates. Rockstar has not confirmed them, and playtime depends on how you play.

The real answer arrives on November 19, when players can clock their own hours. Watch for how the finished trophy list compares with the datamined 55, whether the 200-hour Platinum estimate holds up, and any announcement from Rockstar about its online plans.

faqs.q: How long is the GTA 6 story?
faqs.a: According to TweakTown, citing Insider Gaming's Tom Henderson, the main story reportedly takes about 50 hours across roughly 100 missions. Rockstar has not confirmed this, and playtime varies by player.

faqs.q: How long will it take to get the GTA 6 Platinum trophy?
faqs.a: Henderson reportedly estimates around 200 hours for the PS5 Platinum trophy. That includes photographing 170 different animal species, and he also expects some RNG-based trophies tied to the casino and gambling.

faqs.q: When is GTA 6 launching and does it have online at launch?
faqs.a: The source says the game launches on November 19. Every objective at launch is reportedly single-player or story-oriented, and it is unclear when a GTA Online successor will arrive, though the launch build contains code related to multiplayer modes.
